title: Level 3 – Opinions, situations, emotions, comparison, and abstract ideas

items.sentence: 我認為呢個方法比較有效。
items.jyutping: ngo5 jing6 wai4 ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 bei2 gaau3 jau5 haau6
items.meaning: I think this method is more effective.

items.jyutping: keoi5 jing6 wai4 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3
items.meaning: He believes that learning Cantonese takes time.

items.sentence: 我而家先了解點解佢會咁做。

items.jyutping: ni1 go3 nam2 faat3 kei4 sat6 gei2 jau5 ji3 si1
items.meaning: This idea is actually quite interesting.

items.sentence: 你有冇咩意見想講？
items.jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 me1 ji3 gin3 soeng2 gong2?

items.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3 hou2 jau5 dou6 lei5.

items.sentence: 大家都可以自由發表自己嘅意見。
items.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 faat3 biu2 zi6 gei2 ge3 ji3 gin3.
items.meaning: Everyone can freely express their own opinions.

items.sentence: 我聽完你嘅意見之後，會再諗諗。
items.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 jyun4 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3 zi1 hau6, wui5 zoi3 nam2 nam2.
items.meaning: After hearing your opinion, I will think it over again.

items.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ge3 cing4 fong3 jau5 di1 fuk1 zaap6

items.meaning: Let me understand the situation clearly first.

items.sentence: 我唔知道原因係乜。

items.meaning: The research results are very surprising.

items.sentence: 你睇吓計算嘅結果係啱嘅。

items.meaning: The experiment results proved the theory.

items.sentence: 呢個方法好簡單。

items.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 seoi1 jiu3 zoi3 tou2 leon6

items.sentence: 呢個決定好重要。
items.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hou2 zung6 jiu3

items.sourceWordMeaning: more; even more; to a greater extent
